limitations.lag_grid_is_coarse: Peaks are located on a 250 ms grid, so the reported median lead is 2 grid steps and cannot be read finer than one step.
limitations.shared_dates_only: Only coin-days both venues traded on the same date enter, so this is not a statement about either venue outside that overlap.
limitations.zero_width_interval_returns_no_verdict: The date-clustered interval on the median collapses to zero width on this grid, so no verdict is reported rather than a false one.
limitations.publication_cadence_is_confounded_with_t: The two venues publish at different rates, 100 ms against 541 ms, a gap of 441 ms that is the same order as the 500 ms lead reported here. A slower feed can appear to follow a faster one for that reason alone. The matching correction is applied upstream and cannot be rebuilt from what ships. The panel carries only 12 ms of cadence variation, so the confound cannot be tested here. Across that little variation cadence and the lead correlate at -0.485, whose sign runs against the confound rather than with it, since a slower feed trailing for mechanical reasons would show a larger lead and not a smaller one. Read the result as unable to separate a lead in information from a difference in publication rate, not as evidence that it is the latter.
